mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_phone_verification_receipt (request_id, app_id, account_id, session_id, code_hash, status, expires_at, employee_link_outcome, lease_until) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{appId}, #{accountId}, #{sessionId}, #{codeHash}, #{status}, #{expiresAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, #{employeeLinkOutcome}, #{leaseUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vi_phone_verification_receipt WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND request_id = #{requestId}
SELECT FROM vi_phone_verification_receipt WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND code_hash = #{codeHash}

mapper.update: UPDATE vi_phone_verification_receipt SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler})

UPDATE vi_phone_verification_receipt SET status = 'VERIFIED', phone_lookup = #{phoneLookup}, phone_cipher = #{phoneCipher}, verified_at = #{verifiedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, employee_link_outcome = #{employeeLinkOutcome}, finished_at = #{finishedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}
